claim_text: Pre-2025 data-only state scores distinguish age-associated reference states at the biological-unit level.
blocked_reason: Pooled outer-CV Spearman=-0.7302 after training-only within-cohort age standardisation; higher Y is youth-associated. Association with chronological age is not biological-age validity.

claim_text: Youthward state movement is partly separable from somatic-identity loss and pluripotency-risk movement in partial reprogramming.
blocked_reason: The locked discovery gate passed in GSE165177; the later temporal-order endpoint failed in GSE297234, where youthward movement and risk-axis changes first occurred together.

claim_text: The frozen framework generalizes directionally to post-2024 temporal validation trajectories.
blocked_reason: GSE297984 failed the two-donor/two-day directional gate; six of eight chemical effects were negative. This claim must not appear as supported.

claim_text: Frozen target ranks enrich later-tested mechanisms against matched controls.
blocked_reason: Two of five named targets were absent from the frozen universe; evaluable-only mean percentile=0.56091 and empirical matched-null p=0.33237.

claim_text: The frozen framework does not label the prespecified adverse in-vivo 7c challenge as guarded youthward.
blocked_reason: The guarded rule was not triggered, but tissue identity was unavailable. This is not evidence of specificity or safety.
Requires a separate, auditable accessibility assessment; no peptide efficacy is implied.

claim_text: Several transcriptomic chronological-age directions correctly orient independent young-minus-old controls but do not agree sufficiently across partial-reprogramming interventions.
blocked_reason: Five evaluable methods oriented both controls; median pairwise intervention sign agreement=0.744565, below the locked 0.80 gate. B1 was defined after primary outcomes were visible.

claim_text: A universal scalar transcriptomic rejuvenation direction is unsupported across the eight evaluated favourable-labelled intervention families.
blocked_reason: Zero of five evaluable methods were positive in at least 80% of families; the highest fraction was 0.625. Source labels are not biological ground truth.

claim_text: Intervention-family transcriptomic effect vectors show weak cross-family concordance.
blocked_reason: Median pairwise Spearman=0.053812; median leave-one-family-out consensus Spearman=0.196995. Genes are not treated as biological replicates and no population p-value is claimed.
